d: Jet black hair is styled with straight bangs and a long, thick braid draped over the shoulder, topped with large, white and black feline ears. The eyes are a vibrant magenta with a playful, upturned expression on a youthful, mature face. A slender build is dressed in a gold metallic bra-top, a decorative gold belt with hanging ornaments, a dark flowing loincloth with red accents, and gold bands around the upper arms, thighs, and ankles. Signature details include large gold hoop earrings and a long, thin black feline tail.
